scope.scope: Exploratory short TRAIN-only capacity screen; reused36 TRAIN cases, fit24 updates and probe12 readout
scope.training: Three arms per seed; frozen G0/classifier/prepared heads; only256 channel-adapter weights/biases;250updates; final-only
scope.conditions: C0 reference constant; A_only predicted availability times fit24 B prior; AB predicted availability times predicted B; CT only in normal inference
scope.metrics: Fractions except explicit pp fields; patch means within primary GT-jitter known-nonempty patches, then equal cases
scope.fine: Within-case sum covered fine nodes / sum fine nodes, followed by equal supported cases; patch mean retained separately
scope.overlap: Sampled overlapping patches and repeated predictions are not independent cases or native whole-case volumes
scope.stability: Own-worst2 and matched-worst2 plus case SD are descriptive, not proof of reduced variance
scope.utility: AB mean Dice>both controls; clDice/CLrecall/fine and own-worst2 nonworse; mechanism thresholds are not transferred to between-training utility
scope.mechanisms: Same AB weights, whole8^3 donor field or own availability with donor B; case-by-stratum cyclic+1 donor; each requires>=.1pp,>=8positive cases,and12supported cases
scope.missing: Nulls are not zero or scientific negatives; technical failures do not count as negative results
scope.seeds: All3 retained separately; PRIMARY cannot be rescued by replicas; no best-of3 selection
scope.inference_limit: Availability predicts measurable boundary support, not a vessel veto; no GT mask gates normal inference
scope.conclusion: No native validation, no GTA efficacy proof, no completed research goal, no automatic successor training
